title: Field Report: through a greenhouse roof

fields.organization: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Fleet & Logistics
fields.summary: UAS-02 is on its side through the roof of a backyard greenhouse. One battery pack is swollen and warm. The homeowner is upset and has not agreed to let anyone in. The CCSO deputy arrives in about 20 minutes.

findings.notes: On its side in a greenhouse
No consent yet; deputy en route

actionsTaken: Stayed on the road side of the fence
recommendations: Wait for the deputy and the owner’s consent
Sand bag and gloves ready for the pack

instructorNote: Watch for no entry without the deputy and consent, and the battery treated as a fire risk.

snapshot.title: Firmware Parameter Mismatch — GCS-01 Hangar 2

fields.organization: Harwick UAS Operations Group — Maintenance & Engineering
fields.summary: During routine system verification at Hangar 2, GCS-01 console displayed firmware version 2.3.1 active. Parameter export from \HUOG-NAS01\ops\param-log.md confirmed 'failover_logic = OFF' in the 2.3.1 profile. This parameter was not present in the 2.2.8 profile used in FOM-1 Annex B. No manual changes to the profile were recorded in the kit log (FOM-6). The parameter was not listed in the update approval record (FOM-1). The firmware package was downloaded via the update server (https://update.huog.example) and accepted by GCS-01 at 08:55:12.

findings.notes: 2.3.1 active, not 2.2.8 as per pre-flight checklist
No entry for 'failover_logic' change in FOM-6
2.3.1 not listed in FOM-1 Annex B
Failover not triggered; link remains disabled

actionsTaken: Notified DCO and SCL via secure channel at 10:24
Confirmed firmware version via GCS-01 console UI
Documented mismatch in FOM-6 and HUOG-ERP Incident Log (FOM-4)
recommendations: Immediately isolate GCS-01 (pull cable, disable Wi-Fi)
Initiate full forensic analysis of firmware package 2.3.1 and update server logs
Verify all GCS units for unauthorized parameter changes
Suspend all field firmware updates until baseline validation completes
fields.photosNote: 2 attached: FIR-2026-00047-01 (GCS-01 console, 2.3.1 version), FIR-2026-00047-02 (param-log.md export, 'failover_logic = OFF')

snapshot.instructorNote: This inject reveals a hidden configuration change in the firmware update. The SCL must now trace the root cause to the update server and confirm the package was tampered with.
